coordinate_scope: OSHB KJV note labels are used only as locators into the canonical WEB Psalm coordinate set; no equivalence of translation wording or textual tradition is asserted.

note_extraction.rule: A KJV note opens a WEB/KJV-coordinate segment inside its enclosing MT verse; its segment runs from the next OSHB word through the word before the next KJV note in that same MT verse, or through the MT verse end.

identity_fallback_rule: If a canonical WEB ref has no explicit KJV note, use the identical OSHB/UXLC OSIS ID only when that target exists. Label this structural_identity_no_explicit_note: it is inferred parity, not explicit-note proof.
range_mapping_rule: Map a WEB span by mapping every constituent WEB verse, then cite the ordered OSHB segment locators. Do not collapse to start/end MT verse IDs when two WEB verses occupy one MT verse (Ps.13.5-6) or when an explicit note begins after a title prefix.
validation_rules: all 2461 canonical WEB Psalm refs map exactly once
all 1,042 OSHB KJV note labels are unique and exist in canonical WEB
all OSHB segment word ranges are nonempty
duplicate MT verse targets are represented as disjoint OSHB word segments
MT-only title verses and title prefixes remain unmapped metadata
non_authorizations: no preferred reading or source-tradition preference
no authorship or superscription historicity claim
